items.title: East Potomac Park trees cut as golf rebuild starts
items.now: In September 2026, work began at East Potomac Park. NPS removed more than 60 trees. Officials call that tree work maintenance. A larger golf rebuild was set to start the same week.
items.place: East Potomac Park is a filled river park with public golf, the Hains Point loop, and historic cherry plantings.
items.change: Plans for a championship course could take trail land and cherry groves. Public access to the park loop is not settled.
